guideline: The Cesium ion logo and data credits must stay visible; the terms of service require the ion logo to be prominently displayed and attribution not removed. CreditDisplay renders the credits.
keywords: credits; attribution; ion logo; creditContainer; CreditDisplay; terms of service; cesium credits; hidden credit
do: Keep the credit container on screen and readable, and place custom UI so it never covers it (see C01).
dont: Hide the credit container or the ion logo with display:none or cover it with panels.

guideline: Scene.verticalExaggeration scales terrain and 3D Tiles height; 1.0 means no exaggeration. Any other value distorts relief and slopes.
keywords: vertical exaggeration; verticalExaggeration; terrain; exaggerate; relief; slope; label
do: Show a visible label such as 'Vertical exaggeration x2' whenever the value is not 1.0, and offer a reset to 1.0.
dont: Exaggerate terrain silently, so users read slopes and heights as real.

guideline: EllipsoidGeodesic.surfaceDistance is measured along the ellipsoid surface, not along the terrain. It ignores relief, so it differs from the walked or driven distance.
keywords: distance; measure; ellipsoid; geodesic; surfaceDistance; terrain distance; straight line; measurement label
do: Label the result, for example 'Ellipsoid distance (ignores terrain)', and name the method used.
dont: Show a bare 'Distance' value as if it followed the terrain.
code_good: const g = new Cesium.EllipsoidGeodesic(a, b); label = (g.surfaceDistance/1000).toFixed(2)+' km along ellipsoid';

guideline: Ground elevation and camera height are different values. Use scene.sampleHeight (or globe.getHeight for loaded terrain tiles) for the ground; camera.positionCartographic.height is the camera height above the ellipsoid.
keywords: terrain height; sampleHeight; getHeight; camera height; elevation; altitude; ground height; readout
do: Read ground elevation with scene.sampleHeight or globe.getHeight and label camera height separately.
dont: Show the camera height as the elevation of the point under the cursor.
code_good: const h = scene.sampleHeight(Cesium.Cartographic.fromCartesian(p)); // metres, undefined if not loaded
code_bad: const h = camera.positionCartographic.height; // camera, not ground

guideline: A scale bar is unreliable in tilted or perspective 3D views because ground scale varies across the screen. Treat it as valid only for a top-down view.
keywords: scale bar; tilt; pitch; perspective; oblique; scale; 3d scale; distance legend
do: Show the scale bar only near top-down pitch, or hide it and offer a measure tool instead.
dont: Show a fixed scale bar at any tilt as if it applied to the whole view.
code_good: if (Math.abs(camera.pitch + Math.PI/2) < 0.1) scaleBar.hidden = false; else scaleBar.hidden = true;
code_bad: scaleBar.hidden = false; // always, even at low pitch

guideline: Offer a 2D or flat fallback or toggle for tasks that do not need 3D, and for devices or users that struggle with 3D navigation.
keywords: 2d fallback; scene mode; morphTo2D; flat map; 3d toggle; columbus view; sceneModePicker; low power
do: Provide a 2D/3D toggle and start in 2D when 3D adds nothing.
dont: Force 3D globe navigation for simple reading and measuring tasks.

guideline: Pick features with scene.pick (top object) or scene.drillPick (all objects under the pixel). Handle clicks with a ScreenSpaceEventHandler.
keywords: picking; scene.pick; drillPick; click; identify; ScreenSpaceEventHandler; select feature; hover
do: Use scene.pick for the top feature and drillPick when overlapping features must be listed; check Cesium.defined on the result.
dont: Compute feature hits by hand from window coordinates.
code_good: handler.setInputAction(e => { const o = scene.pick(e.position); if (Cesium.defined(o)) show(o); }, Cesium.ScreenSpaceEventType.LEFT_CLICK);

guideline: Scene.requestRenderMode renders a frame only when the scene changes, which saves CPU, GPU and battery for mostly static maps. Call scene.requestRender() after your own changes.
keywords: requestRenderMode; performance; battery; render loop; requestRender; maximumRenderTimeChange; idle; fps
do: Enable requestRenderMode and call scene.requestRender() after changing entities or state outside Cesium.
dont: Render continuously at 60 fps on a static map.

guideline: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for camera flights: jump with camera.setView instead of animating with camera.flyTo.
keywords: reduced motion; prefers-reduced-motion; flyTo; setView; camera animation; vestibular; motion
do: When prefers-reduced-motion is set, use camera.setView; otherwise flyTo with a short duration.
dont: Always fly across the globe on every search or selection.
code_good: const calm = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches; calm ? camera.setView(opts) : camera.flyTo(opts);
